title: Announcement and Delivery records, indexes, announces and supersedes relations
description:
Cloud only, no sender wired. Add the Announcement table (id, dedupeKey created with a condition, kind, announces links to Stories with the version looked at, releaseAt in UTC, approval none/soft/hard, approvedBy/At, state planned/released/cancelled/withdrawn, createdBy, trigger, append-only history) and the Delivery table (announcement, channel, account, audience, mode automatic/manual, text and image as S3 keys plus content hash, draftedBy, checks with guideline id/version/hash, state, blockedReason, resultUrl, providerId, cost, counts, attempts, supersedes/supersededBy). Add the announces and supersedes relation types. Reads by index only: by dedupeKey, an Announcement's Deliveries, an account's Deliveries newest first, planned Announcements by releaseAt, a Story's Announcements through the relation. No subscriptions; short fields only, no text in the catalog.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: An announcement is decided once (same Story published twice makes one Announcement; a crash between the key and the first Delivery finishes on retry; a publish that qualifies on no channel leaves no row).
- Gherkin: Approval and release (none releases at once, hard gate waits, newer Story version after approval returns to waiting, cancel before release, past releaseAt releases now).
- Gherkin: No text in the catalog (a Delivery row holds no post text, HTML or Markus).
- One live Delivery per Announcement, channel and account; a second needs supersedes, set in one transaction that marks the old one superseded.
- No table scans; every read in the list above is an indexed query.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
